name: Rotaract Club of Presidency University
shortDescription: The Rotaract Club of Presidency University is a student-led service and leadership organization committed to empowering young people through community service, professional development, fellowship, international understanding and meaningful collaboration.
mediumDescription: The Rotaract Club of Presidency University is a student-led organization that brings together young individuals who believe in leadership through service. Operating under Rotary International District 3192, the club provides students with a platform to develop leadership, communication, teamwork and professional skills while actively contributing to the community.
detailedDescription: The Rotaract Club of Presidency University is a student-led service organization that provides young people with a platform to lead, serve, learn and connect. Operating under Rotary International District 3192, RCPU's activities span Community Service, Professional Development, Fellowship, International Service, Club Service, Public Relations, and Sports.
mission: Empower Presidency University students through leadership development, professional networking, and sustainable community impact while connecting university youth with Rotary International District 3192.
vision: To build a generation of socially responsible, skilled and compassionate young leaders who create meaningful impact within the university, the community and beyond.
